sentences.text: On 1.27, add a label such as `ssd=true` to the desired node and set the Pod’s `nodeSelector` to match that label so the Pod runs only on that node.

citations.quote: Add the label `ssd=true` to the nodes which have SSDs.
use a `nodeSelector` to ensure that the DaemonSet only runs Pods on nodes with the `ssd` label set to "true"
